//: Practice drills (app Practice screen, MatchSim cfg.practice; `challenge`: a challenge's feeds, not listed in Practice and not counted in the drills' unlocks; only ever appended, so a drill's index stays): the coach across the net bounces a ball and feeds one of `feeds`, then plays on. spot: where the player starts, m from the net. x: |x| of the target (either side), depth: m from the net.

drills.name: Back glass
drills.desc: Deep balls that come off your back glass. Let them come; take them as they drop.

drills.name: Side glass
drills.desc: Wide balls into the side glass and the corners. Read the angle off the glass.

drills.name: Lobs and overheads
drills.desc: Lobs over you at the net: bandeja, víbora, smash, or back to the glass.

drills.name: Volleys
drills.desc: Balls at you at the net: punch them deep, drop them short, play the angles.

drills.name: Feeds to the drive
drills.desc: Groundstrokes fed to you mid-court, before the glass (data/challenges.json target practice).

drills.name: Short lobs
drills.desc: Lobs that fall short of the service line behind you at the net (smash it out).
